profile.headline: Software Engineer at Lightbeam Health Solutions

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Translate business requirements into software deliverables, including the assembly, integration, and optimization of large, complex data sets into the Enterprise Data Warehouse
● Validated, troubleshot, and improved report functionality by collaborating with internal staff, end users, and customer advocates to identify errors and make changes to existing reports
● Collaborated with a cross-functional team to develop software using Scrum in an agile process, resulting in on-time and high-quality delivery of software products
● Developed and maintained robust application software utilizing C# ASP.NET MVC, Microsoft SQL, and SSRS, with a focus on continuous improvement and optimal performance

positions.title: Technical Solutions Analyst
positions.description:
● 	Perform troubleshooting investigations reviewing front-end applications by gathering information, using troubleshooting tools, shadowing end users, and testing workflows internally and externally
● 	Perform troubleshooting investigations via backend methods by capturing log files, querying tables, updating database fields, and updating/cycling servers
● 	Communicate effectively verbally and in writing to clients and internal stakeholders
positions.insights: Cerner CCL, Problem Solving and +2 skills

positions.title: IT Systems Admin
positions.description:
● Developed SQL queries to extract targeted data sets from an enterprise-level SQL Server Database. 
● Strategized and executed a comprehensive development plan for a data warehouse application, enabling efficient data analysis and reporting.
● Played an active role in supporting the daily operations of the IT department

positions.title: Sales Associate
positions.description:
•	Organized inventory and maintained merchandise on display according to store policies and procedures.
•	Handled retail duties including cashier work and provided quality service toward customers.
